第十二章没被彻底放弃

魏淑萍是又无奈又觉得闺女可怜，啥时候缺过她零花钱。

“不用交，现在家里也有七百块了，在这个年代足够用。以后妈妈一定会挣更多。”

“就是，别为钱发愁，实在不行我去找老爷子要藏起来的钱财呗。”

讲真的，这种向老人伸手要钱的习惯，在独生子女身上很正常，从小就养成了是她们的，都是她们的“霸道”。

“咳咳，你适可而止吧，闫家可不是咱一家，张口就是在破坏团结，老人不主动分钱咱就当钱不存在。”

魏淑萍狠狠掐了孩子爸，想当年他们刚结婚没啥存款，工资都不够造半个月的，剩下半月双方父母家轮着混饭。

哪次离开前不给塞点零花钱，所以啥叫做日子难，不知道，没见过，也不能接受。

闫嫣躺在床上晃着小脚，脑子里却把顾城的“剧情”翻个底掉。

“老爸老妈，顾城可是有意外之财的，老天爷很疼他，送官送钱送女人，咱要不要当当抢他机缘的善人。”

“绝对要当，他的成功有原主的一份付出，原主不死他凭啥骗到白富美，必须抢，狠狠的抢。”

“行，我把机缘全都写在小本本上，咱仨每人一份，互相提醒，别给忘了。”

“还能给忘了，咱家是属貔貅的，贪嘴的很。”

三口露出良善的笑，一切尽在不言中。

顾城站在邮局外打了好几个喷嚏，肯定是闫家人在骂他，但也无所谓了。

之前还想找个朋友在欠条上签上名字，可还钱时间跨度太长，还不如借钱，以后慢慢还朋友，也省得继续丢人。

五百块太大一笔钱了，把能打的人都打了一遍，才口头应允了一百八十块，还远远不够。

直到他把电话打到直属领导那里，难得的难以启齿，难得的难堪。

“我知道你的事了，这次任务不必参加，但钱可以借你，赶紧把麻烦处理掉，不然你的前路很困难。”

“谢谢领导，我一定会赶紧处理，还有欠您的钱我每月从工资里还。”

“毕竟是你理亏，对闫家人态度好一些，要学会低头。”

挂掉电话，顾城吐出口气，未来还有机会，只要领导没彻底放弃他。

Chapter 12 Not completely given up

Wei Shuping was helpless and felt pity for her daughter. She had never needed her pocket money.

"You don't have to pay. We already have 700 yuan at home, which is enough in this era. Mom will definitely earn more in the future."

"That's it, don't worry about money. If it doesn't work out, I'll go find the old man's hidden money."

To be honest, this habit of reaching out to the elderly for money is very normal among only children. It is theirs who have developed it since they were young, and it is their "tyranny".

"Ahem, please stop it. The Yan family is not our family. Opening your mouth is destroying unity. If the old man doesn't take the initiative to share the money, we will treat it as if it doesn't exist."

Wei Shuping pinched the child's father severely, remembering that when they just got married and had no savings, their salary was not even enough to make a living for half a month, so the remaining half of the month was spent by both parents taking turns to make ends meet.

I don't know if I didn't give him some pocket money before leaving, so I don't know, I haven't seen it, and I can't accept it.

Yan Yan was lying on the bed dangling her little feet, while her mind turned over Gu Cheng's "plot".

"Mom and Dad, Gu Cheng has an unexpected fortune. God loves him very much. He sends officials, money, and women. Should we treat him as a good person who robbed him of his opportunity?"

"I must take it seriously. His success was a result of the original owner's contribution. If the original owner didn't die, how could he have deceived Bai Fumei? He must rob her, and rob her fiercely."

"Okay, I'll write all the opportunities in a small notebook, and each of the three of us will have one copy to remind each other and don't forget."

"You can also forget that our family belongs to the Pixiu family, and they are very greedy."

The three of them showed kind smiles, saying nothing.

Gu Cheng sneezed several times while standing outside the post office. It must have been the Yan family scolding him, but it didn't matter.

I wanted to find a friend to sign the IOU before, but the time span for repayment was too long, so it was better to borrow the money and pay the friend back slowly in the future to avoid further embarrassment.

Five hundred yuan was a lot of money. After beating everyone who could be beaten, I verbally agreed to one hundred and eighty yuan, which was far from enough.

It wasn't until he called his immediate boss that he felt extremely embarrassed and unspeakable.

"I know what happened to you. You don't have to participate in this mission, but I can lend you money. Get rid of the trouble quickly, otherwise your future will be very difficult."

"Thank you, leader. I will handle it as soon as possible. I will pay back the money I owe you from my salary every month."

"After all, you are the one who is in the wrong. Have a better attitude toward the Yan family and learn to bow your head."

After hanging up the phone, Gu Cheng exhaled, saying there would still be opportunities in the future, as long as the leader didn't give up on him completely.
